app.name: Northwind Benefits
app.short_description: Life-event checks, deadline and approval in the ticket.
app.long_description: Shows the employee's plan and the enrollment deadline, runs the eligibility checks, shows the procedure for each step, and records the specialist's approval in the core platform. Northwind PEO is a fictional company.
app.installation_instructions: Enter the integration service URL and key, and the IDs of the five life-event ticket fields.
